correctness.rationale: Reconstructs all graph/walk identities, strict-positive Hamiltonicity criterion and exact reflection counts; central-binomial asymptotics give a complete limiting local law with exponential tails; fixed-initial-height finite-horizon meander convergence yields full path independence. Complete-graph boundary and normalized edge/clique quantities are exact. Standalone exhaustive and independent finite checks pass 42,747 assertions; infinite proof relies on classical invariance results rather than enumeration.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Iglehart and later authors establish broad finite-horizon meander limits and fixed-start variants used in the proof; these are credited. They can underwrite a derivation of the current result once the graph mapping and an additional local-run ballot analysis are supplied. No inspected text explicitly gives the graph spectral limit or its two-scale decoupling. Implicit derivability and priority remain a risk.
